_doc: Dodge trainer measurements (src/sim/trainer/dodgeMetrics.ts). nearFactor: a shot that passes within nearFactor x (unit radius + half width) of the player but would not hit him counts as a near miss (a dodge of it is 'unnecessary'). zoneNear: same for ground zones (x zone radius + unit radius). panicGapTicks: move commands closer together than this belong to one panic episode. predictMaxTicks: look-ahead of the 'does this order leave the shot's path' prediction. speedBuckets / widthBuckets: upper bounds (exclusive) of the buckets of the hit-rate table, the last bucket is open. reviewCount: hits kept for the review list. logTicks / pathStep: player position log before an impact (ticks) and its sampling step for the review drawing.
